title: Cloud City: Account, Tools and Access: Cloud Shell & gcloud
city_concept: City Hall Permits & Surveyor Field Tools

beats.name: The City Problem
beats.story: Bea the Baker wanted to build a storefront, but City Hall guards turned her away because she had no surveyor permit or registration badge.

beats.name: The City Solution
beats.story: Mayor Meridian handed Bea an official field toolkit (Cloud Shell) and verified her permit registry (gcloud auth & API Enablement).

beats.name: City Under Stress
beats.story: Bea attempted to open a heavy industrial flour mill without an industrial zoning permit. The request was halted until the zone license was granted.

beats.name: Where Metaphor Breaks
beats.story: In City Hall, permits take 6 weeks of bureaucracy; in Google Cloud, enabling an API takes 8 seconds with gcloud services enable.
